name: "CodeQL Advanced Master"

on:
  push:
    branches: [ "main" ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ "main" ]
  merge_group:                      # Ensures smooth queueing for merge queues
  schedule:
    - cron: '39 16 * * 3'            # Runs automatically every Wednesday at 16:39 UTC

jobs:
  analyze:
    name: Analyze (${{ matrix.language }})
    runs-on: ${{ (matrix.language == 'swift' && 'macos-latest') || 'ubuntu-latest' }}
    permissions:
      security-events: write        # Required to log vulnerabilities in the security tab
      packages: read                # Required to pull secure packages if needed
      actions: read                 # Needed for internal workflow operations
      contents: read                # Allows reading the checkout repository code

    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - language: python
            build-mode: none        # Python doesn't require compiling for analysis

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v7

      - name: Initialize CodeQL
        uses: github/codeql-action/init@v4
        with:
          languages: ${{ matrix.language }}
          build-mode: ${{ matrix.build-mode }}

      - name: Run manual build steps
        if: matrix.build-mode == 'manual'
        shell: bash
        run: |
          echo 'If you switch to a "manual" build mode for compiled languages,'
          echo 'replace this section with your custom project build commands.'
          exit 1

      - name: Perform CodeQL Analysis
        uses: github/codeql-action/analyze@v4
        with:
          category: "/language:${{ matrix.language }}"
